name: Where Love Burns Eternal
source:
In modern-day Rome, a mysterious professor appears, hunting the most depraved souls. The main character must join his retinue and help him find his victims. 

Every evening, she reads her unfinished movie script to her Messire.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Where_Love_Burns_Eternal]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
在现代的罗马，一位神秘的教授出现了，他正在追捕最堕落的灵魂。主角必须加入他的随从并帮助他找到受害者。

每天晚上，她都会给她的相公读未完成的电影剧本。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Where_Love_Burns_Eternal]romance-club.fandom[/url]
